Makes optimistic plans she increasingly can't keep.

warmly enthusiastic about cheap plans and vague about expensive ones

group_norms.norm_text: Monthly check-in in the chat minimum — even if it's just a meme.
No planning threads unless at least two people are confirmed free.
Whoever proposes the plan books the first thing — no leaving it to air.
